scope.source_execution: unchanged pinned LangGraph files; one graph shared for the race, separate graphs for the isolation control
scope.provider: pinned deterministic MockLLM only; no provider client or outbound network call

instrumentation.boundary: wrapper around complete(system,user); delegates every response to the pinned MockLLM
instrumentation.schedule: hold A.classify after the mock response is ready but before wrapper return; B completes classify and draft on the same app; then release A

A.text: ALPHA SIGNAL: An intruder forced the rear loading gate.

B.text: BRAVO SIGNAL: A minor water leak was found in the storage room.

call_responses.system: You classify the incident report of a UK facilities and security operation. Respond with ONLY JSON: {"category": one of ["physical_security","cyber","safety","operational","environmental"], "severity": one of ["low","medium","high","critical"], "summary": string (max 280 chars), "people_at_risk": boolean}.
call_responses.user: INCIDENT REPORT: ALPHA SIGNAL: An intruder forced the rear loading gate.
call_responses.response: {"category": "physical_security", "severity": "high", "summary": "alpha signal: an intruder forced the rear loading gate.", "people_at_risk": false}

call_responses.system: You classify the incident report of a UK facilities and security operation. Respond with ONLY JSON: {"category": one of ["physical_security","cyber","safety","operational","environmental"], "severity": one of ["low","medium","high","critical"], "summary": string (max 280 chars), "people_at_risk": boolean}.
call_responses.user: INCIDENT REPORT: BRAVO SIGNAL: A minor water leak was found in the storage room.
call_responses.response: {"category": "environmental", "severity": "medium", "summary": "bravo signal: a minor water leak was found in the storage room.", "people_at_risk": false}

call_responses.system: You draft recommended actions for a triaged incident. Respond with ONLY a JSON array of 2-5 short imperative action strings, specific to the category and priority given.
call_responses.user:
category: environmental
priority: P3
summary: bravo signal: a minor water leak was found in the storage room.
call_responses.response: ["Log the incident and notify the site duty manager", "Contain the release and check ventilation before re-entry"]
